what_is_missing: The bank and account holder behind the Zid wallet's IBAN (بيانات حساب المحفظة: اسم صاحب الحساب، اسم البنك، رقم الآيبان), under whose account the wallet balance, including COD amounts transferred to it, is held. The help page lists the fields without their values.
route: Wallet page of a verified store, https://web.zid.sa/ (لوحة التحكم > المالية > المحفظة > تفاصيل المحفظة), not held

what_is_missing: Under whose account or licence Zid (زد شب) holds COD amounts collected from end customers before transferring them to the merchant wallet.
route: A question to Zid; the wallet's العمليات list of a store using الشحن المباشر with COD, https://web.zid.sa/, not held

what_is_missing: The payment gateway used in the Mazeed app (بوابة الدفع في مزيد) and under whose account buyer payments for Mazeed orders are held until Zid transfers the merchant's dues. The FAQ says only that the gateway is different and specific to the app.
route: Checkout in the Mazeed app (no address given on the pages read); or a question to Zid

what_is_missing: Who receives and settles card payments taken on SurePay devices linked to زد كاشير, and into which account; the Terms speak of تسوية فورية للمعاملات المالية without naming who settles.
route: A store with زد كاشير and a SurePay device, https://web.zid.sa/ (زد كاشير), not held; or a question to Zid

what_is_missing: Who holds the merchant's funds for payments through بوابات الدفع الأُخرى (Paymob, amwal pay, Tap) and when they reach the merchant. Zid's pages state where each gateway is offered, how it is activated, and (for Tap) a licence; https://zid.sa/ar/paymob/ says payments arrive directly to the merchant's account through payment gateways without naming who holds them.

route: المدفوعات > الدفع لاحقاً in a store dashboard, https://web.zid.sa/, not held; or a question to Zid

what_is_missing: The number of days after which Zid Pay may return to their sources amounts not transferred to the merchant's bank account in Kuwait: the Kuwait document and the Kuwait section of the Terms read x يوم (S01-ZD-022), and the English Kuwait page has no such clause.

Who holds the proceeds of Amazon orders and transfers them to the merchant; the FAQ states when deposits are made (S01-ZD-102) and that Amazon deducts its fees from the sale amount (S01-ZD-101), not who makes the deposit.
route: A question to Zid; منصات البيع > أمازون in a store dashboard, https://web.zid.sa/, not held
